# HR SAGE - Expert-Verified HR Companion for Malaysia
# llms.txt - Information for LLM Crawlers

## About HR Sage
HR Sage is an expert-verified HR companion specifically designed for Malaysia. It provides instant, cited answers derived strictly from the Employment Act 1955 and Industrial Court Awards.

## Product Description
HR Sage is a specialized AI-powered platform that helps Malaysian businesses and HR professionals navigate complex employment law and industrial relations. Our system provides accurate, legally-grounded answers backed by official legislation and court precedents.

## Key Features
- Expert-verified HR guidance for Malaysian businesses
- Instant answers from Employment Act 1955
- Industrial Court Awards citations and references
- Private and secure document handling
- Real-time legal compliance assistance
- Subscription-based access with flexible pricing

## Target Audience
- HR Professionals in Malaysia
- Business owners and managers
- Legal professionals dealing with employment law
- Companies seeking compliance with Malaysian labor laws

## Technology Stack
- AI-powered question answering system
- Stripe payment integration
- Netlify serverless functions
- Secure document vault

## Legal Compliance
All information provided is derived from:
- Employment Act 1955 (Malaysia)
- Malaysian Industrial Court Awards
- Official government publications and legal documents
